children.text: This vision belonged to two pioneers, Dr. Aysha Al Sayyar and Dr. Nawaf Fawaz, who dreamed of creating more than just a school, they envisioned a place where global minds could blossom within the rich fabric of Emirati values.

From day one, our school has been more than a school. It has been a second home, to students, families, and educators who believe that education is not just about grades, but about character, creativity, and community.

Here, young minds are nurtured, challenged, and inspired. Our students explore science, solve problems, design projects, lead teams, speak up, and give back. From early learners discovering the world to graduates stepping into it, every child at SAIS - UAQ is part of something bigger. Our commitment to nurturing well-rounded, responsible, and innovative individuals has guided the school’s steady growth and strong reputation throughout the years.

heading.title: In 1997, nestled in the heart of Sharjah, a vision took root,  one that would grow into a thriving center of learning, leadership, and legacy.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ students planting trees

children.text: The Governance Board regularly convenes to ensure curriculum coordination, protocols, processes, and practices remain consistent and cohesive across all SAIS institutions. In recent years, the Governance Board has formalized the active involvement of parents in the planning and local governance structure of each campus.

Over the past three decades, we have prepared thousands of students for success in higher education and beyond. Our graduates have gone on to attend prestigious universities in the UAE and abroad, and many have established themselves as leaders in diverse fields such as medicine, engineering, technology, public services, and education. Our alumni go on to study in the world’s top universities. They become engineers, doctors, designers, thinkers, and leaders. But most importantly, they leave our corridors as confident, compassionate people ready to make a difference.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ students talking to a teacher

children.text: What makes SAIS - UAQ special isn’t just the curriculum or the technology or even the impressive university acceptance letters, it’s the feeling. The feeling of belonging. Of walking into a school where you’re seen, supported, and expected to succeed. SAIS - UAQ is proud of its past, rooted in purpose, and focused on the future. We are proud to be a school of possibilities. A school that grows with its people and for its people.

As we look toward the future, we remain dedicated to educational excellence, continuous innovation, and the development of compassionate, forward-thinking individuals who are prepared to contribute meaningfully to both local and global communities.
And our story? It’s still being written, by every student who dares to dream, and every teacher who helps them believe they can.

children.text:
I wish to extend a warm welcome to the Sharjah American International School (SAIS - UAQ) community through our website. We hope to provide you with information as well as some examples of what our staff and students achieve here.We are proud of the rich diversity of nationalities represented at SAIS and the manner in which the host country culture enhances the life of the school.

While the prevailing religion is Islam, we host believers of many world religions and respect their beliefs. Our students from kindergarten to grade 12 have a multitude of opportunities to develop, both in and outside of the classroom, because we believe that every child is important and has a unique personality and learning requirements. Our graduates typically go to the best universities in the UAE, Canada, the United States and the UK. We have a strong tradition of excellence in Mathematics, the Sciences, and Information Technology, and have produced engineers, architects and doctors of the highest quality. Athletically, our sports teams routinely take home much coveted cups and medals and are viewed as the teams to beat in most competitions. However, what we are most proud of is the excellent reputation our students have earned in the community by acting responsibly as positive ambassadors for the school while staying close to home or traveling abroad.

Students leaving SAIS are quick to comment on the close bonds they enjoyed with their teachers and, after graduating, return often to our campus to maintain these positive relationships. Our attachment to our students is borne out of our belief that if we care about them as individuals they will ultimately thrive as students. We invite you to explore our website and gain a “feel’’ for what we believe is a really great school to be in!

We express our values through three connected pillars:

We are proudly accredited by Cognia, ensuring the institution meets high standards of academic excellence and continuous school improvement. The school operates under the governance of Sharjah Private Education Authority, maintaining full compliance with educational regulations and quality frameworks in the Emirate of Sharjah.

As part of its commitment to higher education readiness and academic enrichment, SAIS - UAQ is a strategic partner in the Sharakah Program led by the American University of Sharjah (AUS), along with other prominent universities, such as Canadian University, Ajman University, American University in Dubai, American University of Emirates, RIT, Wollongong University, and Skyline University, providing students with access to scholarship pathways, advanced preparatory programs, and collaborative learning opportunities.
These affiliations reflect our dedication to delivering world-class education, fostering innovation, and preparing students to thrive in a global society.

heading.title: Proud Partnerships and Global Standards of Excellence

children.text: The Strategic Planning and Educational Affairs Authority (SPEA) is the official government body responsible for regulating and monitoring private education in the Emirate of Sharjah. SPEA works to ensure high-quality educational standards across private schools and educational institutions by conducting inspections, supporting continuous improvement, and promoting excellence in teaching and learning. The authority also collaborates with schools, parents, and the wider community to enhance educational outcomes and provide students with a safe, inclusive, and future-focused learning environment.
